titulo: A baby born on GTA V's launch day is 13 now
descripcion:
The number: one number behind today's headline.

GTA V came out on September 17, 2013 (Guinness World Records). GTA VI is dated November 19, 2026 (Take-Two Interactive, the game's publisher). That is 4,811 days. The US game ratings board (ESRB) rates GTA VI Mature 17+: generally suitable for ages 17 and up. Someone born on September 17, 2013 is 13 on launch day and turns 17 on September 17, 2030. The age is date arithmetic. The voice is synthetic.

Sources:
https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/news/2013/10/confirmed-grand-theft-auto-breaks-six-sales-world-records-51900
https://www.take2games.com/ir/news/rockstar-games-announces-pre-orders-grand-theft-auto-vi
https://www.esrb.org/ratings/41627/grand-theft-auto-vi/
